headline: Senior Software Quality Engineer  •  Test Automation Architect  •  Quality Platform Engineer
summary: Quality engineer who builds test automation from the ground up. For six years I have designed the frameworks, pipelines, and standards that let Onspring ship an enterprise ASP.NET platform with confidence. I test across UI, API, and database layers; write production C#, TypeScript, and Rust; and build the practical tooling, including CLIs, agent skills, and MCP servers, that lets AI agents work reliably against real systems. Before software, I was a food scientist working under USDA and FDA rules, and I hold a degree in biochemistry. That background is rare domain knowledge for validating nutrition computations.
